title: Planned maintenance: nbn services via Mayfield (2MYF) POI, NSW
current_summary: Planned maintenance is scheduled on our network backhaul at the NBN Mayfield (POI 2MYF) in NSW. The work window is from 12:00 AM to 7:00 AM AEST on Monday, 10 August 2026. NBN services delivered via this POI may be interrupted for up to 7 hours during the window while fibre splice relocation works take place. Our team and network partners will work to minimise downtime, and services should restore automatically once the work is complete. No action is required from customers.

updates.content: Planned maintenance will affect nbn services that connect via the Mayfield (2MYF) Point of Interconnect in NSW. An upstream network provider is relocating fibre splices. Services may be interrupted at times for up to 7 hours during the window. The maintenance window is Monday 10 August, 12:00 AM to 7:00 AM AEST. We are monitoring the work and will provide updates if anything changes. No action is required from customers.
